caveats: ⚑ hitRatePct 5.04 (×3 stacks) is the kit-literal Hit Rate value; the Hit-Rate→core-rate CONVERSION magnitude (sim.ts hrCoreMult) is derived, not measured for this unit. Her whole offensive contribution runs through it.
⚑ Both hitCount triggers (60 / 120 landed normal attacks) fire on a cadence set by the SMG pulls-per-second tuple, a datamine-unreliable field. Stack uptime and heal frequency scale directly with it.

⚑ Shooting Manual max-stack UPTIME is an estimate: 60 rounds per stack against a 5 sec per-stack duration means max stacks hold only while the 60-round interval stays under 5 sec. Un-measured against a real fight.

The 'Shooting Manual status' / 'at max stacks' gates on skill2 have no engine primitive (self-buff-status gating does not exist; requiresTargetStatus is boss-scoped, resourceGate is pool-scoped). Moot today because both gated lines are unmodeled for lack of a StatKey — it becomes load-bearing only if either line gains one.

The engine models a heal as a recovery EVENT with no HP amount, so both heal lines are offensively inert on their own; they are kept because on-recovery consumers (heal-synergy kits) read those events.
note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Misato (SMG/Iron/Supporter/Burst I) is a sustain/support unit with essentially no direct damage line — she carries zero flatDamage, zero DoT, zero ATK buff. Her only damage-relevant effect is a self Hit Rate stack (5.04% ×3, 5 sec, refreshed every 60 landed rounds), which reaches the damage model solely through the Hit-Rate→core lift. Skill 2 is two continuous team lines that the schema cannot express: 'Damage dealt to Shield ▲ 150%' has no StatKey and is inert at scope lock (the boss carries no shield), and 'Outgoing healing ▲ 30.05%' scales a heal AMOUNT, which the engine does not model (heals are recovery events without an HP quantity). Both are recorded verbatim in unmodeled rather than approximated. Burst is a 5-tick heal-over-time to all allies (5.06% of the caster's final Max HP per tick, 1 sec interval, 5 sec) authored as ticks:5 so each tick emits its own recovery event and keeps on-recovery consumers refreshed — collapsing it to a single event would under-fire them 5:1. Skill 1's second line heals the lowest-HP-percentage ally, modeled as alliesLowestHp count 1 (the engine resolves this to the leftmost ally as a documented stand-in, since v1 has no HP pool); the target choice moves no damage. FB-by-timing left at the default (noFb unset); noRange is engine-automatic.
